scoring_justification: Main claim scores recomputed from raw predictions.csv; model performance uses T0 threshold check as training cannot be rerun in the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: white and grey triangle vertex compositions and their paper-reported average predicted thermal conductivities
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'the white triangular region is 7+-2 W m-1 K-1 ... grey is 16+-3 W m-1 K-1' and explicit vertex compositions given in the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Exact vertex compositions and average target values are explicitly stated in the paper; tolerances derived from reported error bars (+-2, +-3) widened to +-30% for toolchain spread.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: 'R^2 > 0.65 and MSE <19' for selected models.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Direct thresholds from paper's model selection criteria.

outputs.description: Validation performance of the selected composition-only regression model. The solver must train and choose a model meeting R² > 0.65 and MSE < 19 W² m⁻² K⁻²; the checker verifies these thresholds.

Raw per-composition predictions of lattice thermal conductivity. The checker recomputes the average predicted κ for the white and grey triangle regions and compares them to hidden reference values, and also checks that the Ba-field average is lower than the Sr-field average.

output_contract.notes: The DFT probe-structure energy calculations are excluded (taskability scope). The two required scored outputs are model performance (thresholds) and the raw prediction table (recomputed for triangle averages). The training and validation split is the solver's choice; the checker uses paper-reported thresholds for model quality and paper-reported triangle averages for the main prediction claim.
